answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy can hang on a bonded registration stake rather than on identity checks. Each new agent must post a non-refundable deposit and tie it to one credential slot on a shared reputation trellis, so running N fake agents costs N deposits. Because the stake sits on every ledge of the trust graph, a fake network must pay that price per node. A single honest vine of referrals cannot be cloned cheaply, and any agent caught faking loses the stake.
